Figure 4 tests whether compartment (surface / deep / rhizosphere) imposes
a stable depth gradient, whether host-plant identity (from iNaturalist)
reshapes the rhizosphere signal, and which genera are diagnostic of each
compartment.

* **A.** Shannon diversity by compartment × trip with a mixed-effects
  model (site as random intercept).
* **B.** Paired surface–deep Shannon contrast per trip.
* **C.** Indicator-species analysis per compartment (IndVal).
* **D.** Rhizosphere stratified by iNaturalist-matched host plant.

```{python}
#| label: setup
import sys
from pathlib import Path
REPO = Path.cwd().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO / "src"))

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from eq import CACHE_DIR, FIGURES_DIR
from eq.diversity import shannon, richness, aggregate_to_rank, relative_abundance

plt.rcParams.update({"figure.dpi": 120, "font.size": 9,
                     "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False})
```

## Load tables

```{python}
ft = pd.read_parquet(CACHE_DIR / "feature_table.parquet")
tax = pd.read_parquet(CACHE_DIR / "taxonomy.parquet")
meta = pd.read_parquet(CACHE_DIR / "metadata.parquet").dropna(subset=["trip","compartment"]).copy()
meta["trip"] = meta["trip"].astype(int); meta["site"] = meta["site"].astype(int)
ft = ft[meta.index]
meta["shannon"] = shannon(ft)
meta["richness"] = richness(ft)
palette = {"surface": "#d62728", "deep": "#1f77b4", "rhizosphere": "#2ca02c"}
print(meta.groupby("compartment")[["shannon","richness"]].mean().round(2))
```

## A. Shannon by compartment × trip + mixed-effects

```{python}
#| label: fig4a
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
# Random intercept per site
mod = smf.mixedlm("shannon ~ C(compartment, Treatment('deep')) * C(trip)",
                  data=meta.reset_index(), groups="site")
res = mod.fit(method="lbfgs")
print(res.summary().tables[1])
```

```{python}
#| label: fig4a-plot
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
import seaborn as sns
sns.boxplot(data=meta, x="trip", y="shannon", hue="compartment",
            palette=palette, ax=ax, fliersize=2, linewidth=0.8)
ax.set_xlabel("trip"); ax.set_ylabel("Shannon (H')")
ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8, title="")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(FIGURES_DIR / "fig4a_shannon_by_trip.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
```

## B. Paired surface–deep Shannon per trip

```{python}
#| label: fig4b
from scipy.stats import wilcoxon
paired_rows = []
for trip in sorted(meta["trip"].unique()):
    m = meta[meta["trip"] == trip]
    s_tbl = (m.groupby(["site", "compartment"])["shannon"].mean()
               .unstack("compartment"))
    if {"surface", "deep"}.issubset(s_tbl.columns):
        pair = s_tbl.dropna(subset=["surface", "deep"])
        if len(pair) >= 3:
            w = wilcoxon(pair["surface"], pair["deep"])
            paired_rows.append({"trip": trip, "n_pairs": len(pair),
                                "mean_surface": pair["surface"].mean(),
                                "mean_deep": pair["deep"].mean(),
                                "deep_gt_surf": int((pair["deep"] > pair["surface"]).sum()),
                                "W": float(w.statistic), "p": float(w.pvalue)})
paired = pd.DataFrame(paired_rows)
paired.to_csv(CACHE_DIR / "paired_surface_deep.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)
paired
```

```{python}
#| label: fig4b-plot
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))
for trip in sorted(meta["trip"].unique()):
    m = meta[meta["trip"] == trip]
    s_tbl = (m.groupby(["site", "compartment"])["shannon"].mean()
               .unstack("compartment"))
    if {"surface", "deep"}.issubset(s_tbl.columns):
        pair = s_tbl.dropna(subset=["surface", "deep"])
        for _, row in pair.iterrows():
            ax.plot([trip - 0.15, trip + 0.15],
                    [row["surface"], row["deep"]],
                    color="grey", alpha=0.3, lw=0.4)
        ax.scatter([trip - 0.15] * len(pair), pair["surface"],
                   color=palette["surface"], s=18, alpha=0.7)
        ax.scatter([trip + 0.15] * len(pair), pair["deep"],
                   color=palette["deep"], s=18, alpha=0.7)
ax.set_xlabel("trip"); ax.set_ylabel("Shannon (H')")
ax.set_xticks(sorted(meta["trip"].unique()))
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(FIGURES_DIR / "fig4b_paired_surface_deep.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
```

## C. Indicator species per compartment

```{python}
#| label: fig4c-indval
# Simple IndVal: A_ij = mean abundance in group / mean across all groups
# B_ij = frequency in group / total frequency across all groups
# IndVal = sqrt(A * B), with p-value via 999 permutations of the grouping.
from scipy.stats import rankdata
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)

gen = aggregate_to_rank(ft, tax, rank="genus")
gen = gen[gen.index != "unclassified"]
rel = relative_abundance(gen)

def indval(rel, groups, n_perm=199, top_n=20):
    """Return top_n indicators per group."""
    groups = pd.Categorical(groups)
    lvl = list(groups.categories)
    obs = np.zeros((rel.shape[0], len(lvl)))
    for j, g in enumerate(lvl):
        idx = np.where(groups == g)[0]
        mean_g = rel.iloc[:, idx].mean(axis=1)
        mean_all = rel.mean(axis=1)
        a = mean_g / mean_all.replace(0, np.nan)
        b = (rel.iloc[:, idx] > 0).mean(axis=1)
        obs[:, j] = np.sqrt(a.fillna(0) * b)

    # Permutation test for p-values (quick)
    null_max = np.zeros_like(obs)
    for _ in range(n_perm):
        perm = rng.permutation(len(groups))
        pg = groups[perm]
        for j, g in enumerate(lvl):
            idx = np.where(pg == g)[0]
            mean_g = rel.iloc[:, idx].mean(axis=1)
            mean_all = rel.mean(axis=1)
            a = mean_g / mean_all.replace(0, np.nan)
            b = (rel.iloc[:, idx] > 0).mean(axis=1)
            null_max[:, j] += (np.sqrt(a.fillna(0) * b) >= obs[:, j])
    p = (null_max + 1) / (n_perm + 1)
    out = []
    for j, g in enumerate(lvl):
        top = np.argsort(obs[:, j])[::-1][:top_n]
        for k in top:
            out.append({
                "compartment": g,
                "genus": rel.index[k],
                "indval": float(obs[k, j]),
                "p": float(p[k, j]),
            })
    return pd.DataFrame(out)

indicators = indval(rel, meta["compartment"].values, n_perm=199, top_n=15)
indicators.to_csv(CACHE_DIR / "indicators_per_compartment.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)
for g, grp in indicators.groupby("compartment"):
    print(f"\n== {g} ==")
    print(grp[["genus", "indval", "p"]].head(10).to_string(index=False))
```

## D. Rhizosphere stratified by host plant

```{python}
#| label: fig4d
plants = pd.read_csv(CACHE_DIR / "plants_by_site_trip.tsv", sep="\t")
plants = plants[plants["rank"].isin(["species", "genus"])]

# Collapse to one "dominant host" per (site, trip) — highest-confidence observation closest to the site
plants["host_genus"] = plants["scientific_name"].str.split().str[0]
host_map = (plants.sort_values("distance_km")
                  .drop_duplicates(["site", "trip"])
                  [["site", "trip", "host_genus"]])

rh = meta[meta["compartment"] == "rhizosphere"].copy()
rh = rh.merge(host_map, on=["site", "trip"], how="left")
rh["host_genus"] = rh["host_genus"].fillna("unknown")

print("Rhizosphere samples by dominant host plant:")
print(rh["host_genus"].value_counts().head(10))
print()

# Shannon by host genus (only hosts with ≥5 samples)
hosts = rh["host_genus"].value_counts()
keep = hosts[hosts >= 5].index.tolist()
print(f"Hosts with ≥5 rhizosphere samples: {len(keep)}")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4))
rh_plot = rh[rh["host_genus"].isin(keep)]
import seaborn as sns
sns.boxplot(data=rh_plot, x="host_genus", y="shannon",
            order=sorted(keep), ax=ax, fliersize=2, linewidth=0.7,
            color="#2ca02c")
ax.set_xlabel(""); ax.set_ylabel("rhizosphere Shannon (H')")
plt.xticks(rotation=35, ha="right")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(FIGURES_DIR / "fig4d_host_plant.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
```
